note: Screen-recorded end-to-end run with an external wallet, 2026-09-28, one unedited take on paiflow.xyz. A registered USER account (testusera, not in the alpha cohort) built on_receive XLM → swap (XLM→USDC via Soroswap, 0.8% slippage) → pay (full amount, USDC) in the builder, deployed it with Freighter through the app's factory, triggered it with 25 XLM from Freighter, then minted a deployment API token on the deployment page and executed the same deployment twice through /api/v1 from the published Postman collection, each envelope signed locally with the Stellar CLI (key d4-partner). The human half of SOW §5.1 week 4's "End-to-end integration test with external wallet"; 01–03 are the scripted half.

notCovered: The deploy transaction and the two API transactions are not opened on stellar.expert in the take; their links are below. The API leg uses the Postman collection rather than the curl lines of the integration guide; both call the same three endpoints. At about 7:03 the desktop clipboard manager opens for about two seconds over Postman and shows the full deployment token; that token was minted for this run only, and it can prepare, submit and read events for this one deployment but cannot move funds, since every envelope must be signed by the depositor's own key.
